How to unlock:

1. First, unlock Production Techniques of the Great Lighthouse recipe book (see its page for steps).
2. Speak to Murshid on Candia (east of tavern)
3. Talk to three NPCs in any order you like at:

※Benghazi - Stout Man (near Item Shop/Market keeper NPCs)
※Athens Nervous Man (the left-corner side of the town mini-map or directly SW from Harbor Port Official)
※Famagusta Stubborn Man (standing at the right side of the tavern)

4. Talk to Murshid in Candia twice.
5. Set sail from Candia, heading east-northeast. The new Sea of Wonders entrance will be waiting for you.
6. Enter the Sea of Wonders and clear three maps in the time allotted to discover The Colossus of Rhodes.
7. Speak to Murshid to report discovery; recipe book is unlocked.
※ Report your findings to Murshid back in Candia.

ALTERNATIVE ROUTE:

Find a player who has done the above steps, and ask them to take you into Sea of Wonders. Complete steps 6 and 7 to permanently unlock access to book without having to do steps 2 through 5.
